description: This file defines the 'Membership' entity class within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It maps the 'Membership' class to the 'ohrm_membership' database table using Doctrine ORM annotations, including properties for 'id' and 'name' with their respective getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Membership
classes.description: Entity class representing a membership record in the HR system, with properties for ID and name, and mapped to the database table 'ohrm_membership'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the membership.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the membership.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the membership.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the membership.
